title: 朧月夜 (Oboro Tsukiyo — Hazy Moonlit Night)
description: A hauntingly beautiful 1914 song about a spring evening where everything dissolves into haze. Rapeseed fields glow in the fading sunset, mountains disappear into the mist, and a pale crescent moon hangs in the spring sky. Then all the details of the village — the firelight, the forest, the path, a traveler, frogs calling, the temple bell — blur together into one soft, dreaming, hazy moonlit night.
